title: Lane token can create private krn-works outside test repos
body:
Why: t-d19z692 could not start. `gh repo create krn-works/outside-php --private --source . --remote origin --push` (same for outside-npm, outside-py) exits 1 with "GraphQL: Resource not accessible by integration (createRepository)" under the krn-works-delivery[bot] installation token (GH_TOKEN). The only credential able to create the repos is the operator's personal keyring login, which the lane is not granted to use. Scratch copies (secret scan clean, one commit each) are ready in /mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside/{php,npm,py}: php=lightweight-rekurencja-antyspam, npm=tallystick (src/ledger/schema.sql dropped by the sanitize rule), python=krn-search.
Outcome: a documented, granted path to create private krn-works outside test repos unattended (App permission Administration:write on krn-works, or an operator-created empty repo pool outside-php, outside-npm, outside-py with the App installed), so t-d19z692 can run.
Proof: `gh repo create krn-works/outside-probe --private` under the lane token exits 0; then rerun t-d19z692 steps 3 and 4.
